description: Use when you need a cited research brief on a question (not a token rug check). Returns a short answer, key points and sources. $0.01 per call via x402 on GET /report?q=. No RugRadar credit key, and no free daily check. depth defaults to standard (more sources, can take longer) at the same price; pass quick for a shorter brief with fewer sources. lang defaults to en. For a URL's text use read_page; for recent headlines use news_search. Invalid or failed calls are not charged. With no payment, the tool returns error=payment_required and the x402 Payment Required challenge for the HTTP route; pay that USDC amount, then retry the URL.

depth.description: default standard. standard uses more sources and can take longer, same ${rp.report} price; quick is shorter with fewer sources

lang.description: default en; sources and wording prefer this language when available

name: research_brief

outputSchema.description: Success fields on a paid/authorized call, or error/payment_required fields. Additional properties may be present.

error.description: payment_required, bad_input, or a failure code

payWith.description: x402 payment requirement for the HTTP route, plus credit-key instructions when those apply

priceUsd.description: USDC price to pay when error is payment_required

refunded.description: true when a credit was taken and then returned because the call failed

title: Cited Research Brief
